title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - TestSuiteExecution
description: REST resource for the test suite execution lifecycle (TM Forum TMF708 Test Execution 4.0.0, Swagger definition TestSuiteExecution; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:TestSuiteExecution:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TestSuiteExecution'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF708_TestExecution/blob/v4.0.0/TMF708-TestExecution-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestSuiteExecution/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:TestSuiteExecution:<tmfId>. unique identifier

dataCorrelationId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF708_TestExecution/blob/v4.0.0/TMF708-TestExecution-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestSuiteExecution/properties/dataCorrelationId'. Data correlation ID passed in by the API consumer

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF708_TestExecution/blob/v4.0.0/TMF708-TestExecution-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestSuiteExecution/properties/name'. Name of the related entity.

generalTestArtifact.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF708_TestExecution/blob/v4.0.0/TMF708-TestExecution-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestSuiteExecution/properties/generalTestArtifact'. A reference to a managed general test artifact resource. In TMF this is an array of GeneralTestArtifactRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced GeneralTestArtifact entities (urn:ngsi-ld:GeneralTestArtifact:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
